restrictions: Two-block 112-byte messages m = M0||B2 (M0 a free 64-byte first block, B2 48 bytes whose FIPS padding fixes block-2 schedule words W12=0x80000000, W13=W14=0, W15=896), hashed under sha256-r38-prefix-v1 semantics from the standard IV with standard feed-forward and full 256-bit digest. Cap-priced search over exactly K = 2^105 independent uniform M0 trials with a deterministic FAILURE branch; per trial charged 1 + 8/38 + 120/38 target compressions and 1900/C word operations: full block-1 compression, the 8-round block-2 W7 validity gate, and — charged to EVERY trial, not only gated survivors — four full block-2 tail evaluations (rounds 8..37 each, 4*30/38) over the 4 values of the freedom pair (W14,W15), with 1900 ordinary ops (70 backward W0..W6 derivation + 4*132 schedule expansions W16..W37 + 4*306 condition extraction/compare/branch + 42 gate bookkeeping); plus at most 2 + 200/C final verification compressions/ops. No restart or amplification.

Upstream development travels with the ported characteristic (collision-frontier-v5 nonuniform-advice rule): the ePrint 2026/1120 SAT/SMT characteristic search, printed at 2^38.3 target compressions by its authors, is charged whole as preprocessing at the rounded-up power 2^39, included in total time. No zero-inherited-development claim is made; preprocessing_log2=39 is that term's own ledger, not the total.

Classical probabilistic 256-bit word RAM, collision-frontier-v5, C = 2728; worst-case batch bounds include the unsuccessful batch. Success probability 0.864 is derived from cap K and the disclosed per-trial rate 2^-104 (heuristic H1); under the disclosed worst-case padding reading (rate halved twice, Kq = 1/2) success is at least 0.3935 at unchanged time. No PRNG substitution for independent uniform coins; memory is a reported metric only.

heuristics.statement: For the 38-step signed-difference characteristic of ePrint 2026/1120 (Tables 3-4), a uniform 64-byte first block M0 passes the A_{-1}-validity check (4 bit conditions on W7) with probability 2^-4, and each surviving M0 has exactly 102 independent unbiased bit conditions on (A_i, E_i, W_i), 16 <= i <= 37, each of the 2^2 values of the freedom pair (W14, W15) satisfying all of them with probability 2^-102, so per-trial success probability is at least 2^-104 and the capped batch of K = 2^105 independent trials returns a verified pair with probability at least 1 - e^(-K * 2^-104) >= 1 - e^(-2) > 0.86.
heuristics.scope: Success probability of the ported two-block MITM on this target's padded message family only. The time bound does NOT depend on it (cap-priced). It does not establish trail validity (H2) or operation counts (enumerated directly in the ledger).
heuristics.extrapolation: The condition count 102, the freedom 2^2, and the gate 2^-4 are the paper's own enumeration (Section 3.1 complexity paragraph and Table 4); its printed total 2^104.3 compressions is reproduced from these counts in our ledger section 'Reproduction'. Disclosed sensitivity: one effective halving of the per-condition rate gives success >= 1-e^(-1) = 0.632; two halvings give >= 1-e^(-1/2) = 0.3935; both exceed the 0.39 policy floor at unchanged time_log2.
heuristics.limitations: Independence and unbiasedness of the 102 conditions across the freedom pair and across trials is assumed, not proved; this is the standard working premise of the Manger/LLW/LLWS26 differential-attack framework from which the ported characteristic comes. A sampled experiment cannot meaningfully probe the 2^-104 regime, so none is declared.

heuristics.statement: The signed-difference characteristic transcribed from Table 3 of ePrint 2026/1120 is a valid 38-step SHA-256 differential trail: for modular message differences nonzero only at schedule indices 7..11, 15, 16, 23, 25, the step updates admit the stated (nabla A_i, nabla E_i) pattern with zero final eight-word difference after feed-forward, so any message pair completing all bit conditions of the trail collides under sha256-r38-prefix-v1.
heuristics.scope: Collision soundness of the construction on this target's exact prefix-round, feed-forward, full-digest semantics.
heuristics.extrapolation: Demonstrated by re-executing the paper's semi-free-start witness (Table 5) against the organizer reference core verifier/hash_functions.py:_compress with rounds=38: both blocks hash to digest 5d9ca5f4...90645c4d from the paper's CV, and the block-1 modular word differences are nonzero exactly at indices 7,8,9,10,11,15, matching the transcribed in-block pattern (transcript quoted under 'Reproduction'). One instance cannot prove the trail for all inputs; the full trail table is quoted from the source.
heuristics.limitations: A single SFS witness instance plus the printed trail equations; no exhaustive machine verification of the trail was performed in this package. If H2 fails, the shipped verification step turns the batch into a deterministic FAILURE rather than a wrong answer, so the ledger is not breached.
